source_anchors.matched_line: self:project(tg, x, y, DamageType.FIREBURN, {dur=5, initial=0, dam=data.power + data.inc_stat})
self:project(tg, self.x, self.y, DamageType.FIREBURN, {dur=6, initial=0, dam=dam})
self:project(tg, x, y, DamageType.FIREBURN, {dur=8, initial=0, dam=t.getDamage(self, t)}, {type="flame"})

claims_to_verify: For each of fireburn-ref-026, fireburn-ref-028 and fireburn-ref-035, the displayed damage argument is one total scalar passed as dam with an explicit duration and initial=0.
FIREBURN with initial=0 deals no immediate damage and applies dam/dur per turn across the explicit duration when no prior burning effect is present.
Existing burning effects merge by conserving old plus new remaining damage while recomputing duration; the tooltip describes the newly applied contribution, not a guaranteed standalone tick schedule.
Pyrokinesis uses FLAMESHOCK while Transcendent Pyrokinesis is active; that projector likewise divides dam by dur over six turns, so the same tooltip total remains valid.
The three editable Chinese targets must not imply that the displayed total is dealt every turn; the short Heat Beam control contains no duration claim and must remain unchanged.
